title: Greeter survives a grace-time unlock; every later lock starts no greeter ("QProcess::start: Process is already running") and leaves a black screen with only a cursor
line: Locking the screen again after an unlock in grace time now always shows the lock screen, even if the old lock screen process got stuck.
explanation: An unlock within the grace time unlocks at once and only sends SIGTERM to the greeter. If that greeter doesn't exit (on the reporter's NVIDIA machine it ignored it), KSldApp keeps it in m_lockProcess, and the next lock calls QProcess::start() on a process that is still running, which only warns "Process is already running". The session is then locked with no greeter: a black screen with no password field. Now the grace-time unlock SIGKILLs the greeter if it is still running two seconds after the SIGTERM. If the screen is locked again before that, startLockProcess() kills the old greeter and starts the new one from its finished signal, so KWin never waits for it.

commits.message:
ksldapp: Kill a greeter that doesn't exit after a grace time unlock

An unlock in grace time only sends SIGTERM to the greeter. If it doesn't
exit, the next lock can't start a new greeter and leaves a black screen,
so kill it after two seconds, or right away when the screen locks again.

BUG: 528681

media.caption: Master: greeter stalled during a grace unlock, Lock 3 s later: session locked, no greeter, black screen (journal: "QProcess::start: Process is already running")
With the fix, same steps: the stuck greeter is killed 2 s after the unlock and the next lock shows the lock screen
Master: same black screen when locking again right after the grace unlock
With the fix, Lock 0.5 s after the grace unlock: the old greeter is killed at once and the new lock screen starts when it has exited

review.text: Fixes the real failure in KSldApp: a greeter that survives the grace-time SIGTERM blocks QProcess::start, so the next lock has no greeter. Escalating to SIGKILL after 2 s (pid-checked) and deferring the new start to the finished handler instead of blocking KWin is sound, and the pending state is handled in unlock, logind unlock and Immediate upgrade. Why the reporter's greeter ignores SIGTERM is still unknown, but making ksldapp robust to it is right on its own. Media and verification show black screen before and the greeter after, including the lock-again-at-once path.
